author: Nagendra Ghimire
review_text: During festival time, I booked sumo from Kathmandu to Birgunj. Bus sewa partnered with Kathmandu Sumo Pvt Ltd, falsely advertised regular sumo operating on the route as reserved bus and charged me almost double price, without meeting basic criteria like departure time and sumo's ability to reach destination. In my opinion, this is irresponsible move to online tickets and esewa's failure to check quality of buses. The grievance I raised was not properly addressed either.
